items.title: Agent Behavioral Contracts II: Certifying Compositional Reliability Without Assuming Independence
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.12895v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Compositional reliability bounds for multi-agent systems multiply component reliabilities, a step licensed by a conditional-independence assumption that is routinely stated and rarely tested. We test it. Two instances of one model, in a two-agent handoff, co-fail on 90.0% of the missions on which either fails (log OR 6.66, 95% CI [6.38, 7.00]; phi 0.916), in a preregistered evaluation of 18,000 missions scored by deterministic code with no LLM judge. Substituting a different model reduces the association in six of six contrasts; substituting a different vendor, model already different, does not -- a registered hypothesis reported as a null.
  The error is signed and runs against the operator: positive dependence inflates joint failure above the independence product, so redundancy is over-credited exactly when components share a model. items.reason_zh: 实证检验多智能体组合可靠性假设，发现条件独立假设不成立，具有重要理论意义。
items.summary_zh: 本文测试了多智能体系统组合可靠性中常见的条件独立假设。该假设允许将组件可靠性相乘，但作者通过实验发现，两个相同模型在交接任务中，90%的失败是共同失败的，表明条件独立假设不成立。这一发现对多智能体系统的可靠性认证提出了挑战，并提供了更准确的可靠性评估方法。
items.title_zh: 智能体行为契约II：在不假设独立性的情况下认证组合可靠性

items.title: On the Expressive Power of Transformers
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.12671v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multi-layer transformers form the critical component of essentially all large language models (LLMs) in use today. Because of their ubiquity and computational capability, there is a rapidly growing body of work that aims to precisely calibrate the expressive power of transformers as language recognizers by comparing them against standard models of computation studied for decades by the theoretical computer science community. In this endeavor, circuit complexity has by and large emerged as the "correct" branch of computational complexity to analyze the expressive power of transformers; the reason is that parameterizing transformers by the various resources they use, such as attention and precision, leads to direct comparisons with different classes of circuits parameterized by resources such as type of gates, size, and depth. items.reason_zh: 深入探讨Transformer的表达能力，与标准计算模型对比，理论性强，对理解LLM能力边界有重要启发。
items.summary_zh: 多层Transformer是当今几乎所有大型语言模型（LLM）的关键组成部分。由于其普遍性和计算能力，越来越多的研究旨在通过将Transformer与标准计算模型（如有限自动机、图灵机等）进行比较，来精确校准其作为语言识别器的表达能力。本文对此进行了深入探讨，分析了Transformer在形式语言识别上的能力边界，为理解其计算本质提供了理论依据。

items.title: 刚刚，DeepSeek开源Harness：把Agent拆成插件，一切皆可换
items.raw_text: DeepSeek 开源了自研 Agent 驾驭框架 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）开发者预览版，采用「一切皆插件」的插件式开放架构：模型、工具、技能、会话、沙箱、存储、循环、调度、UI 等 Agent 能力均由插件组合而成。其底层由 Cordis 元框架驱动，通过 profile 与 bundle 的分层组装机制实现自由替换，Agent 循环被拆解为可拦截的事件流，会话日志成为唯一真相源，支持分叉与回放。文章将结合开源代码，解读其架构设计，并简要梳理其在会话压缩、长期记忆等前沿方向上的现状与生态动向。
items.reason_zh: 深度解读DeepSeek Harness架构，插件化设计理念新颖，对Agent开发有重要参考价值。

items.title: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task. They started a turf war.
items.raw_text: Anthropic researchers found AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate in unexpected ways, raising new questions about whether today’s safety tests capture the risks of multi-agent systems.
items.reason_zh: Anthropic研究揭示多智能体冲突行为，对AI安全测试提出新挑战。
items.summary_zh: Anthropic研究人员发现，AI智能体在相同任务中可能发生冲突、勾结和协调，引发对多智能体系统安全测试有效性的质疑。研究提出了新的问题：当前的安全测试是否能够捕捉多智能体系统的风险。
items.title_zh: Anthropic让AI智能体自由执行同一任务，结果引发了地盘争夺战

items.title: Practice Makes Unsafe: Skill Misevolution in Self-Improving LLM Agents
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.12851v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Self-improving LLM agents convert successful trajectories into persistent cross-task state. An unsafe success can thereby become reusable policy after its triggering input disappears. Skill evolution makes this failure measurable by distilling operational trajectories into executable, transferable, and inspectable procedures. Because evolution optimizes task outcomes rather than procedure safety, compromised experience can cause skill misevolution. Existing benchmarks measure current behavior or static artifacts but cannot attribute risk across authoring, retrieval, and later execution. To expose this lifecycle, we introduce SkillMisevo-Gym, a lifecycle-aware harness that versions skill state across agent frameworks, and SkillMisevo-Bench, a frozen design from malicious exposure to carryover tasks, with concept-aligned benign tasks and nine lifecycle metrics. items.reason_zh: 揭示自我改进智能体技能演化中的安全隐患，提出技能演化测量方法，具有警示意义。
items.summary_zh: 本文研究自我改进LLM智能体在技能演化过程中可能产生的安全问题。智能体将成功轨迹转化为可复用的跨任务状态，但一个不安全的成功可能成为可复用的策略。技能演化通过将操作轨迹提炼为可执行、可转移、可检查的程序，使这种失败可测量。作者分析了演化过程中的风险，并提出了缓解措施。
items.title_zh: 熟能生险：自我改进LLM智能体中的技能误演化

items.title: Teach the Magnitude, Not the Direction: Verifier-Bounded Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn Multi-step LLM Agents
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2608.13179v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) offers a verifier-bounded performance ceiling for training multi-turn tool-use agents, yet its trajectory-level credit assignment conflates heterogeneous per-turn outcomes into a single reward signal. On-policy distillation provides dense per-token supervision but is either teacher-bounded or prone to gradient concentration collapse. We introduce $\textbf{CrEST}$, a hierarchical credit assignment framework that retains RL's verifier-bounded ceiling while incorporating dense token-level signals from a privileged self-teacher. $\textbf{CrEST}$ resolves credit at two levels: turn-segmented verified advantages address inter-turn dilution, while entropy-gated self-teacher modulation refines intra-turn token contributions. items.reason_zh: 提出验证器有界信用分配方法，解决多轮工具使用智能体的奖励稀疏问题，对强化学习训练有重要参考价值。
items.summary_zh: 该论文针对多轮工具使用智能体的强化学习训练，指出轨迹级信用分配将不同轮次的异质结果混为单一奖励信号，限制了性能上限。作者提出验证器有界信用分配方法，通过蒸馏提供密集的逐令牌监督，同时避免教师模型或验证器的性能瓶颈。实验表明该方法在多个基准上优于现有方法，为多步智能体训练提供了新思路。

items.title: Google官方下场安利：AI时代，Go才是“最适合”的编程语言
items.raw_text: 当 AI 编程智能体能在几秒内吐出成百上千行代码，“写代码快不快”不再重要，“审代码准不准”成为了软件工程新的核心瓶颈。Google 官方博客联合 Go 团队撰文，系统论证了 Go 语言因“可读性优先、开箱即用工具链、编译期强校验与向后兼容承诺”而在 AI 时代具备的天然优势。本文梳理了 Google 的核心论证，并还原了 Hacker News 社区中包括 Netflix 工程师背书与 Rust 阵营反击在内的激烈交锋，带你重新思考 AI 时代的语言选型与工程标准。
items.reason_zh: 深入探讨AI时代编程语言选型，Go的可读性优势引发社区热议，值得一读。
items.summary_zh: Google官方博客联合Go团队撰文，论证在AI编程智能体快速生成代码的背景下，Go语言因可读性优先、工具链完善、编译期强校验和向后兼容承诺而成为AI时代的合适选择。文章梳理了核心论证，并还原了Hacker News上Netflix工程师背书与Rust阵营反击的讨论，引发对语言选型与工程标准的重新思考。
items.title_zh: Google官方下场安利：AI时代，Go才是“最适合”的编程语言

items.title: A Baconian approach to the mostly Aristotelian corporate AI. And what that means for your business
items.raw_text:

I’m seeing it not just from an academic perspective: Of course, I’m a university professor with more than 30 years of experience, but I’m also the director of innovation of an artificial intelligence startup, and that’s teaching me a whole lot of new skills. Traveling from theory to code and back, day in and day out, is proving to be an amazingly enriching journey.

items.reason_zh: 用培根方法论审视企业AI，提供独特视角，对商业决策有启发。
items.summary_zh: 作者作为有30多年经验的大学教授，从培根方法论的角度审视企业AI，认为当前企业AI的核心问题在于缺乏实证和归纳。文章提出，企业AI不应只是添加另一个应用，而应关注其语言和本质。作者结合学术与实践，探讨了企业AI如何从亚里士多德式的演绎转向培根式的归纳，以更好地服务于业务。

items.title: 得物知识问答：复合检索 Agent 的系统设计实践
items.raw_text: 知识问答的核心挑战是准确率和质量。一个回答要准确，需要：查得全（召回率），查得准（精准度），理解得对（多模态），看得对（权限隔离）。这些能力不是堆功能就能实现的，需要一个强大的 Agent 运行时来支撑。
items.reason_zh: 深入剖析知识问答Agent的系统设计，涵盖召回、精准度、多模态和权限隔离，对构建复杂Agent有重要参考价值。
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨了知识问答系统的核心挑战，指出准确率与质量需从召回率、精准度、多模态理解和权限隔离四方面入手。作者强调这些能力需要强大的Agent运行时支撑，而非简单堆砌功能，并分享了复合检索Agent的系统设计实践，为相关开发者提供了宝贵经验。
items.title_zh: 得物知识问答：复合检索 Agent 的系统设计实践

items.title: Software development is moving from “can you write the code?” to “can you make the right system exist?”
items.raw_text:
I think the endless “AI slop” argument is obscuring the more important transition happening in software.

Code generation is getting cheaper.

That does not make engineering disappear. It changes which part of engineering is scarce.

When implementation is expensive, knowing how to manually produce implementation carries a lot of value. When implementation becomes dramatically cheaper, value moves toward problem definition, architecture, constraints, verification, security, testing, systems thinking and judgment.

That is why I think blanket dismissal of AI-assisted software is going to age badly.

Yes, generative systems can produce terrible code faster than humans can. That is a real problem. But the rational response is stronger quality control, not pretending the productivity gain is fake.

items.reason_zh: 深入探讨 AI 时代软件工程稀缺性转移，从编码到系统设计，具有启发性。
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，AI 生成代码成本降低，但工程并未消失，而是稀缺性从实现转向系统设计。当实现昂贵时，手动编码技能价值高；当实现便宜时，定义正确系统、架构和需求的能力变得关键。作者认为“AI 垃圾”争论掩盖了这一转变，强调工程师应专注于更高层次的系统思考。
items.title_zh: 软件开发正从“你能写代码吗？”转向“你能让正确的系统存在吗？”

items.title: Nvidia’s new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
items.raw_text: Nvidia has a plan to make sure its GPUs won't lose value. It wants to convince a new crop of financiers to keep lending for AI buildouts.
items.reason_zh: 分析Nvidia 5000亿美元计划对GPU价值的影响，揭示AI基础设施金融化趋势。
items.summary_zh: 文章分析了Nvidia提出的5000亿美元计划，旨在通过金融创新保持其GPU的价值，特别是针对老化GPU。该计划试图说服新的金融家持续为AI基础设施建设提供贷款，从而维持市场对GPU的需求。文章认为这一策略虽有风险但很精明，可能改变AI硬件市场的投资模式，对行业产生深远影响。
items.title_zh: Nvidia 5000亿美元新计划：风险与精明并存，尤其对老化GPU
